published_ranges._ams: AMS, AMS 2 PRO, AMS HT, AMS Lite
published_ranges._notes: Cooling fan is printed only as 'Turn on'; no fan % range is published. Other drying options: X/P/H2 printer heatbed at 80C for 12 h; AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT at 60C for 12 h (filament inserted) or 65C for 8 h (not inserted). Plates: Textured PEI, Smooth PEI or Cool Plate SuperTack, with glue recommended. Bambu says PETG Matte is not recommended as a support for PLA. Launch date 2026-09-28 per Bambu's own forum post 'PETG Matte is here! Prints like PLA, lasts like PETG' (forum.bambulab.com/t/260388), which, per its search preview, says it 'is available now in Bambu Lab Store in 8 vibrant colors'. The individual colour names come from secondary coverage (3dprintpricing.pro). A Bambu PETG Matte system preset was not confirmed, so the parent is PETG Basic. Earlier entry: TDS V1.0 (reseller-hosted copy linked from 3DJake). Plates: Textured PEI, Smooth PEI, Cool Plate SuperTack. Cooling fan: turn on. Support material: Support for PLA/PETG. Melting temp 160C (DSC) as printed. Max overhang ~70 deg, bridging ~30 mm.
